name: Noël
source:
Twin of Buchel that has been cross dressing since his younger days. Despite looking like his sister is opposite personality of being laid back and friendly to everyone. Will occasional tease/flirt with protagonist who still has a hard time believing he is a man. Despite not being a good athlete is a good maid that works for others professionally and is quite skilled in various tasks. Of the two twins is recognized as the more talented and reliable one. 

Likes: [url=/c42551]Ojousama[/url]
Dislikes: Exercise
Hobbies: Taking care of [url=/c39108]Bûche[/url]
